note: Machine-readable review scenarios for docs/LAB_QA_GUIDE.md. kind is real (evidence from the committed snapshot) or synthetic (fixture rows; never a claim about the data). Commands are run from the repository root. tests/test_lab_qa_catalog.py checks that every referenced case, fixture, file and make target exists.

scenarios.question: Does the lab preserve the published trade-off: rules has the higher F1 at recorded settings, learned has higher precision and a smaller queue with lower recall and coverage?
expected: snapshot.json#methods.rules_v1.metrics.f1.value > snapshot.json#methods.learned_v1.metrics.f1.value
learned precision.value > rules precision.value
learned counts.review_queue.value < rules counts.review_queue.value
learned recall_labelled.value < rules recall_labelled.value and learned coverage.value < rules coverage.value
every metric value in snapshot.json equals the artifact value at its source_key (tests/test_lab_export.py)
the Compare view names no universal winner and states the thresholds differ
scenarios.perturbation: Edit a copy of artifacts/lab/snapshot.json so that rules_v1.metrics.f1.value is lowered; `make lab-check` must report the file as stale (hash mismatch) and exit 1; the committed file is untouched.
scenarios.disproof: An evaluation artifact in which learned_v1.metrics.at_auto_accept.f1 exceeds rules_v1's, or a snapshot metric whose source_key resolves to a different value.

scenarios.question: When the review floor changes to an exported value while the accept threshold and gap stay at the method's recorded values, are the queue parts and the recall upper bound read from the artifact rather than interpolated?
expected: for every point queue_total == queue_floor + queue_ambiguity
queue_ambiguity is identical across floors of one method
the corrected floor_sweep over the replay bundle equals the artifact points (floor_sweep_reconciliation.all_equal)
floors at or above accept_min are listed as omitted and are not selectable
a queue budget below the smallest queue_total yields 'no supported setting meets this budget'
scenarios.perturbation: In the Compare view enter a budget of 0; then a budget above the largest queue_total: the feasible list is empty, then contains every exported floor.
scenarios.disproof: A floor point whose queue_total differs from the sum of its parts, or a floor offered by the UI that is not in the artifact's points.

scenarios.question: A record whose top candidates tie at the maximum score is sent to review by the ambiguity rule; and does re-applying a lower accept threshold keep it in review instead of reusing the stale demotion flag?
expected: all three exported rows of the case have top2_gap 0.0, tier review and ambiguity_demoted_derived true
the case's labels block shows the chosen B is not the truth B for the methods that chose it
fixture: baseline decision review with demoted false; at accept 0.75 corrected decision review with demoted true; legacy sweep accepts 1 at 0.75, corrected sweep accepts 0
replay_rules_v1.json#legacy_sweep_divergence.thresholds_differing > 0 and every differing threshold is below the recorded accept_min
scenarios.perturbation: Change the fixture's second value from 0.76 to 0.60 (gap 0.20): the corrected decision at accept 0.75 becomes auto_accept and the legacy and corrected sweeps agree; run `make lab-fixtures` and the test to see the expected values move together.
scenarios.disproof: A replay row with gap below ambiguity_gap and value at or above the swept threshold that the corrected sweep counts as an accept; or a legacy point above the recorded accept_min that differs from the corrected one.

scenarios.question: When methods choose different B ids for one A record, does the lab show it as disagreement between methods, separate from within-method ambiguity, and does the local truth say which chosen B is right?
expected: comparison.agreement_class == methods_disagree with distinct_chosen_b_ids 2
exact_v1 and learned_v1 chose the same B in auto_accept; rules_v1 chose a different B with top2_gap 0.0 in review
labels.per_method marks the exact/learned choice correct and the rules choice incorrect
fct_lab_case_comparison carries the same agreement class (dbt test passes)
scenarios.perturbation: In the bundle copy, set the rules row's b_id equal to the exact row's: `make lab-check` reports a stale cases.json; and after `make dbt` on such a copy the reconciliation test would fail.
scenarios.disproof: A case classified methods_disagree whose exported rows all carry the same b_id.

scenarios.question: An auto-accept on an unlabelled record counts toward coverage and unverified accepts, never toward precision or recall; does every surface say so?
expected: the case is labelled false with no truth_b_ids and at least one auto_accept row
policy.evaluate counts it in accepted_all and unverified_accepts.count but not in at_auto_accept.accepted
with no labelled rows precision, recall and F1 are null in both evaluators (zero_denominators fixture)
the case view shows 'unlabelled' and no correctness claim
scenarios.perturbation: Mark the fixture row labelled with top1_correct true: precision becomes available and unverified_accepts.count drops by one.
scenarios.disproof: Any evaluator output where an unlabelled row changes precision or recall.

scenarios.question: Are reachable-labelled recall and overall-labelled recall computed over different denominators, and does the replay bundle carry truth reachability from the full blocked set rather than from displayed candidates?
expected: replay completeness.labelled_reachable equals eval labelled_a_reachable and completeness.labelled equals labelled_a
recall_overall == round(correct / labelled_a, 6) and recall_labelled == round(correct / labelled_a_reachable, 6)
a queued labelled row whose truth is unreachable does not raise recall_with_review
cases.json labels carry truth_reachable_full separately from truth_visible_in_exported_choices
scenarios.perturbation: Set truth_reachable false on the fixture's correct accepted row: the row still counts as a correct accept in the numerator, but labelled_a_reachable falls, so recall_labelled rises above recall_overall/pair_completeness consistency and the invariant test flags it.
scenarios.disproof: A replay row whose truth_reachable was derived from the two displayed values instead of the full candidate set (n_candidates would not match candidates.parquet).

scenarios.question: Is a single candidate shown with a null gap (never zero or a perfect gap) and never demoted, and is a no-candidate record kept in the population as reject with reason no_candidate?
expected: the single-candidate case has gap_state single_candidate and top2_gap null on the exported row
the no-candidate case has three not_exported rows with reason no_candidate and labels.n_candidates_full 0
fixture: single candidate rows are never ambiguous; no-candidate rows are reject with reason no_candidate and tier shares still sum to one
replay completeness.with_candidates + without_candidates == a_records_in_file
scenarios.perturbation: In the fixture give the single-candidate row v2 = v1: it becomes a tie (gap 0) and is demoted to review.
scenarios.disproof: A single-candidate row with gap 0 or 1 in any export, or a no-candidate record missing from the replay population.

scenarios.question: Do local review actions change only the effective state and consequence counts of the selected case set, leaving the frozen benchmark metrics byte-identical?
expected: accept adds an effective accepted B; a second accept supersedes it; reject_candidate records a rejected B without asserting no match anywhere; defer sets deferred; undo appends a reversal and restores the prior state
at most one effective accepted B per (scenario_id, a_id)
the Compare metrics table text is identical before and after the actions (Playwright assertion)
the Python validator accepts the exported ledger (parity)
scenarios.perturbation: Import the exported ledger with one event's seq duplicated: the import is rejected and nothing is applied.
scenarios.disproof: Any change in snapshot-derived numbers after a review action, or two effective accepts for one A in one scenario.

scenarios.question: Does an exported receipt validate against its schema, and is a receipt or ledger from another snapshot rejected rather than applied?
expected: the receipt carries the decision question, population and grain, snapshot ref with digest, method and policy versions, selected controls, constraints, observations with source keys, assumptions, alternatives, chosen action, rationale, limitations and outcome status not_observed
a receipt whose snapshot.analytical_digest differs is refused with 'incompatible snapshot'
hostile rationale text is rendered as text; a 5000-character rationale is rejected by maxLength
scenarios.perturbation: Edit the exported receipt's snapshot_id by one character and import it: refused; restore it: accepted.
scenarios.disproof: An import that applies events from a different snapshot_id.

scenarios.question: Does a missing replay input become a declared limitation, and does a stale or hand-edited export fail the check instead of being rewritten or replaced by synthetic data?
expected: complete_replay.learned_v1.available is false with the no-frozen-model note; the Replay view disables learned_v1 and shows the note
`make lab-check` exits 1 on any altered byte under artifacts/lab and rewrites nothing
export without data/ and without --no-local refuses to overwrite owner-run outputs
no file under artifacts/lab is outside the allowlist
scenarios.perturbation: Append a space to a copy of artifacts/lab/cases.json in a scratch directory and run the check against it (tests/test_lab_export.py does exactly this).
scenarios.disproof: A check that passes on an altered file, or an export that produced replay rows for learned_v1 from the rounded mapping.

scenarios.question: Can the six-decimal exhibit classify a gap that rounds to the ambiguity threshold, and does the lab defer to the unrounded local value instead of certifying from the rounded one?
expected: the rules_v1 row has gap_at_rounded_boundary true, tier review and ambiguity_demoted_derived false (the rounded value cannot explain the tier)
labels.per_method.rules_v1.unrounded_gap is below the ambiguity gap and unrounded_ambiguous is true
fixture exact_gap_boundary: a gap exactly equal to the threshold is not ambiguous; one ulp below is
scenarios.perturbation: Rebuild cases with --no-local: the row keeps the boundary flag but the labels block becomes truth_unavailable, so the tier stays unexplained rather than guessed.
scenarios.disproof: A rounded gap equal to the threshold that the exhibit-derived flag classifies as demoted.

scenarios.question: Do the readable synthetic cases reproduce the documented mechanics, is every view badged synthetic, and can nothing synthetic reach a real figure?
expected: every id matches SYN-A-nnn or SYN-B-nnn and no real exhibit id appears
every title and artist token is in the fixture vocabulary
expected decisions per preset reproduce under policy.decide_row and policy.ts
the downstream duplicate-join demo inflates joined rows while conserved_row_count stays equal to the fact rows
receipts cannot be exported from the sandbox and synthetic events are namespaced synthetic:*
scenarios.perturbation: Change a synthetic score in a copy to cross the accept threshold: the expected decision in the copy changes and `make lab-check` reports the committed fixture stale.
scenarios.disproof: A synthetic count appearing in the Compare view or a receipt.
